facts.fact: 章首正要告诉 Lucas 遇上兜帽人——惨叫划破夜空（转折）；Lucas 拉她躲避命她回家，她口头答应却抗命
facts.anchor: but he was already wrapping his arm around her and pulling her next to a darkened cottage and out of sight.

facts.fact: Bernice 家门板脱铰链；黑色利爪扒门框，外露利齿、通体黑眼、非人非兽的巨兽现身
facts.anchor: Heavy footfalls trudged through the home a moment before a black, clawed hand clung to the doorframe.

facts.fact: 怪兽把 Bernice 砸在 Andra 面前——额头淌血探不到生命迹象；她的风攻击旋即熄灭
facts.anchor: The monster ripped something from over its shoulder and slammed it onto the ground between them with a sickening crunch.

facts.fact: Lucas 三箭同时钉进怪兽肩部；数十名防御队员赶到巷战
facts.anchor: Three arrows planted themselves simultaneously into the firm muscles of the monster

facts.fact: 怪兽吐黑雾灌进 Bernice 喉中——被附身重新站起，双眼变黑
facts.anchor: The black vapor slid down Bernice’s throat.

facts.fact: 附身 Bernice 掐喉提空，称她 Cecilia 光女巫之女、要偿母罪——母亲之名 Cecilia 首次揭晓
facts.anchor: “Daughter of Cecilia the Light Witch,” she began again, “it is time you pay for your mother’s sins.”

facts.fact: 恶灵命她去"一切开始与结束之地"——背叛王座上 Vasara 等她（Vasara 之名首现）
facts.anchor: You must journey to the place where it all began, and where it ended. Upon a throne of betrayal, Vasara awaits your arrival.

facts.fact: 限冬至月出前到场受审，否则每天屠村中一人
facts.anchor: You have until moonrise on winter solstice to appear for your judgement.

facts.fact: Bernice 夺回身体告白后亲手把刀刺进自己腹部；黑雾逃出另寻宿主，巨兽遁入黑夜
facts.anchor: With trembling hands, Bernice plunged the blade into her abdomen.

facts.fact: 转场 Bernice 幸存（淤伤+缝合刺伤）；Fergal 证实母亲死时超过一百岁
facts.anchor: Did you say before the great war? That means she would have been over one hundred years old when she died.

facts.fact: 核心真相：母亲就是传说中决战对抗 Edgeron 的光女巫；Edgeron 就读东北海岸学院=开始与结束之地；Fergal 年岁成谜
facts.anchor: Your mother was the light witch that stood against Edgeron in the final battle.

facts.fact: 章末：不顾反对宣布独行赴约；Lucas 怒斥她不会用全部元素不练格斗"一天就会被猎杀"——决裂摔门
facts.anchor: Andra stormed past the man she called her best friend and out the door.
